name: hoh1-installed
about: With this machine's own HoH1 import (the mods' source folders carry the local content tools/import_hoh1.py wrote): the Forsaken Tower's HoH1 levels, the HoH1 pets and the HoH1 trinket icons report installed, and hwplib does not tell the player about stand-ins. The HoH1 class art is a packed-only overlay, so the classes mod is left out here.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:pets\] \d+ HoH1 pet\(s\) in the Pet Shop
steps.name: the HoH1 pets

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] campaign: Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content installed
steps.name: hwp hoh1: campaign installed

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] trinkets: Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content installed
steps.name: hwp hoh1: trinkets installed

steps.pattern: \[HWP:hoh1\] on stand-ins|Heroes of Hammerwatch 1 content is not installed
steps.name: no stand-in notice
